title: REGISTRAR site patch layer (L2 + L3)
description: The only mutable surface in the system. A patch file describes how one organisation differs from the mandated spine — and nothing else. It lives in the site's own version control and is never committed to this repository. Every row is a (change, inverse) pair: without the inverse the row is not a well-formed element of the patch monoid and cannot be mounted at all. See SPEC.md §2 and §3.

site.description: Identifies the organisation this fit belongs to. Deliberately minimal: this file describes an operation, not a population.

id.description: A slug the site chooses for itself.

row.description: One difference between this organisation and the seed.

target.description: A local_variation id declared by an L0 element — see core/lifecycle/lifecycle.yml. The seed enumerates its own mutable surface; a target that is not declared there does not exist. A target naming an L0, L1 or L4 object fails the blast-radius gate.

value.description: The change. Any JSON value the target accepts.
value.$comment: Deliberately untyped here; the target's own declaration constrains it.

inverse.description: What restores the prior state at the state where this row is applied. MANDATORY. A row without a genuine inverse is not an element of the monoid and mount is undefined on it (SPEC.md §3). The local-invertibility gate computes p-inverse(p(lambda)) and compares; a plausible-looking inverse that does not actually invert is caught there. If the prior value cannot be determined, that is a STOP condition, not a field to fill with something reasonable.
inverse.$comment: null is a legal inverse only when the target genuinely had no prior value.

evidence.description: Pointers into the SITE's own material. Not this repository — the seed says nothing about any particular organisation, so it can never be evidence for a site fact. Not general knowledge. Not 'standard practice'.

source.description: A locator precise enough for a reviewer to check in under a minute: document and section, ticket query, config path, tape span.

says.description: What the source actually establishes — not a restatement of the row. A citation to a document that does not contain the claim is worse than no citation, because it survives casual review and fails audit.

kind.description: Where it came from. 'observation' carries the least weight and the gate treats it accordingly.

shadow_run.description: A replay of this row against the site's own historical cases, before it is offered. A row nobody replayed is a guess with formatting.

cases.description: Denominator. A count without one is not a count.

expiry.description: The date this row must re-earn its place. Nothing is permanent by default: an operation that changed and a row that did not is exactly the drift this field exists to surface.

author.description: The named human who signs. An automated author MUST leave this empty — a machine's output is a candidate, and the signature is what makes the mount legitimate. An empty author is legal in a draft and fatal at mount time.

layer.description: Optional and advisory; the target's own declaration is authoritative.

supersedes.description: The id of a row this replaces. Retirement unwinds through inverses in reverse dependency order (SPEC.md §3, T2) — a correction is a new row, never an edit to an old one.

id.description: Stable identifier for this row, so it can be superseded and audited later.
